svg.title: Flask power against enemy scaling
svg.desc: One panel per configuration and Elden Ring slot. Flask charges and potency are each a percentage of their own maximum; enemy is the seed's own normalised regionSphereTargetRanges.
svg.text: Charges over their 4-to-14 range, potency over 0-to-12, enemy over its own ceiling.
Flat early means the flask is done climbing while the run is not.
